question: Does omitted native-normalizer information explain native physical-coefficient decoding error?

design.question: Does omitted native-normalizer information explain native physical-coefficient decoding error?
design.normalization: Actual installed native FP32 kernels: Bolt whole128; TimesFM cumulative32/64/96/128 prefix stats, applied patchwise. No weights or forward passes.
design.target: Physical injection coefficients derived by joint fixed-frequency Fourier projection of query-minus-background with DC nuisance. Normalized targets project actual normalized endpoint differences or paired endpoints within normalization spans.
design.inverse: normalized_delta: sq*pred+(sq/sb-1)*Cb with observed past-only background coefficients. normalized_pair: sq*predq-sb*predb, no background-coefficient correction. Average restored patch coefficients.
design.features: Only observed raw/normalized histories, saved hidden states, and endpoint native means/scales. No generating amplitude, phase, source identity, condition labels or coefficient labels as covariates.
design.controls: Matched input delta/pair with same target and inverse; metadata-only; hidden plus metadata; shuffled first feature block with metadata unchanged; training-mean and zero normalized predictions restored identically.
design.cv: Leave-one-source-out; all dependent rows held out together. Fixed alpha=.01; train-only scalar RMS per block; equal block-kernel weight; no tuning or p values.
design.primary: Native first-block physical_delta versus normalized_delta and normalized_pair, hidden-only versus hidden+metadata, with matched inputs and inverse-only controls; all other cuts and locked policy descriptive.
design.limits: Reused8 instrumentation sources; phase/source confounding persists. Decoder failure cannot establish missing information; a corrected decoder does not establish causal semantics or training attribution.
design.native_capture: NONE: no model checkpoint or native forecaster instantiated

controls.description: Matched input delta/pair with same target and inverse; metadata-only; hidden plus metadata; shuffled first feature block with metadata unchanged; training-mean and zero normalized predictions restored identically.

limitations: Reused8 instrumentation sources; phase/source confounding persists. Decoder failure cannot establish missing information; a corrected decoder does not establish causal semantics or training attribution.
evidence_class: Descriptive8-source held-out linear decodability with history-only inverse normalization; not causal feature semantics
next_decision: Coordinator may ledger audited findings. Fresh32-source crossed-phase design is prepared; HOLD native capture while dictionary/comparability own slots.
interpretation: Omitted native normalization is a substantial measurement confound in direct physical-coefficient decoding. Corrected decoding supports accessibility with specified observation/inverse side information; it does not demonstrate hidden-only physical information or causal feature semantics.
feature_label_note: The result feature='hidden' describes the ridge covariates only. For normalized_delta, physical restoration ALSO uses observed background Fourier coefficients and actual endpoint native scales. These are history-only side information, supplied identically to every input/metadata/mean/zero/shuffled control. No generating coefficients, amplitudes, phases or source IDs are covariates.
endpoint_qualification: Paired normalized endpoints avoid the background-coefficient correction, but corrected hidden and matched-input errors are similar. No blanket hidden-over-input dominance is claimed; direct physical input differences remain a much stronger accessible baseline.
